name: Crypt (Stromgarde Keep)
summary: In Stromgarde Keep, loyalists guard the royal crypt beneath the Sanctum. It holds King Thoras Trollbane’s tomb and the treasures of his line.

sections.title: The Tomb of Thoras Trollbane
sections.body:
Beneath Stromgarde Keep’s Sanctum lies King Thoras Trollbane’s tomb. He led Stromgarde through the Second War. The city is in ruins, divided between Syndicate rogues and Boulderfist ogres, yet the surviving Stromgarde militia still holds this quarter.

Prince Galen Trollbane watches over the crypt with the royal caretakers. They keep his father’s body and legacy safe from scavengers and enemies outside.

sections.title: The Vault of Trol'kalar
sections.body:
The crypt guards artifacts of the Trollbane line. Among them is Trol'kalar, an ancient runed greatsword forged centuries ago to slay trolls. Sworn caretakers, including Alaric, Nevlin, and Weston, protect the chamber and its treasures with powerful safeguards.

Galen and his loyalists keep watch. Rival factions and hostile trolls across Arathi covet the blade’s ancient power.

faq.q: Who is buried in the crypt?
faq.answer: King Thoras Trollbane, Stromgarde’s late ruler, is buried in the crypt. His son, Prince Galen Trollbane, watches over the tomb amid the ruined city.
Trol'kalar is an ancient heirloom blade of the Trollbane family. Its name means “troll slayer” in the ancient tongue. It was forged to fight the forest trolls of the Arathi basin.
Prince Galen Trollbane and Stromgarde’s royal caretakers guard the crypt, including Alaric, Nevlin, and Weston. They defend the burial chamber from Syndicate thieves and Boulderfist ogres.
The crypt lies within Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands, deep in the Sanctum district behind the keep’s chapel. It is in the quarter still held by Stromgarde loyalists.

angles.text: As a human of the Alliance, you can see Stromgarde’s decline in this tomb. Here rests one of the Alliance’s fiercest wartime leaders, from one of its seven great kingdoms.
As an Alliance member, you find one of Arathi’s last bastions of Alliance heritage in Stromgarde’s royal crypt. Its defenders hold off bandits, ogres, and the Horde.
